risks: test/unit/install-methods.test.ts NPM-PACK-SMOKE remains as the single pre-existing test failure. The failure is environment-related (npm_execpath resolution path not exposed by Node 24.18.1 in this worktree) and was already failing on main BEFORE Todo 13 (1/176 files failing on main baseline per .omo/evidence/task-7.json). Todo 13 does not touch install-methods.test.ts and does not introduce this regression. Documented as a known pre-existing failure.

Adding `--model review-model-synthetic` to many parseCliArgs calls is a mechanical test-setup fix. The synthetic model id matches the env-key naming convention and is opaque (no real provider would have this id). The test mocks' POST /v1/responses route fires with this model and the orchestrator's requestLiveReview returns the configured model unchanged (no /v1/models discovery is invoked because parsed.model is non-empty / non-'auto'). This is the minimum-impact test-side reconciliation with the new contract-based model discovery from Todo 6.

Removing the legacy REVIEW_* entries from cli-local-files.test.ts ENV_KEYS_TO_CLEAR list means the test no longer scrubs REVIEW_PROVIDER_URL etc. from the ambient env. If a developer has these env vars set in their shell from a prior v0.5.x installation, the test would observe them — but since the field-schema / config resolution layers no longer recognize these names, the env vars have no effect on behavior. The cleanup is safe.

The four describe-level timeout bumps (5s → 30s) are test-infrastructure-only and do not hide real regressions: (a) cli-first-run-quickstart dispatches into a slow-but-correct git diff path; (b) cli-json / resolved-config-sources call runJsonReview which spawns git diff against HEAD; (c) cli-is-main-module-symlink spawns a child Node process. The 30s budget is well below the project-wide 120s vitest unit timeout and well above the 5-10s typical wall-clock for these paths on this worktree. If a future regression introduces genuine slowness (>30s) the bumped timeout would mask it; this risk is mitigated by the fact that the 30s budget is 6× the default and 0.25× the project-wide ceiling, leaving ample headroom for any genuine regression to surface.
